The '''lylek''' was the most dangerous predator indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], one of the few creatures able to survive in the harsh [[Bright Lands]].

==Anatomy==
[[File:Lylek_RS11BT3.png|thumb|left|200px|A seemingly deadly battle with a [[virtual reality]] lylek]]
Lyleks were tall beasts protected by a thick [[exoskeleton]] and armed with sharp, spear-footed [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], powerful jaws, and overpowering tentacles.

Few creatures were able to survive on the stifling, arid surface of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]; the lyleks were aggressive and deadly and preyed on each other when no other food source was available. They were known to crawl deeply into the inhabited caves and threaten [[City/Legends|city]] dwellers. Inhabited caverns and underground cities were protected by [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] and traps to prevent lylek attacks.

In addition to their viciousness and strength, the lyleks' tail tentacle was also tipped with a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] barb. The poison itself was not deadly, but it was disabling enough to prevent most creatures from escaping.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lylek_nest.png|thumb|A lylek nesting site]]
{{Quote|The terrifying, bloodthirsty monster known as the lylek is named after my wife Kelly. Errrr&hellip; Wait, that came out wrong&hellip;|Dan Wallace|<ref name="blog" />}}
Author [[Daniel Wallace]] named this creature by rearranging the letters in the name of his wife, Kelly.<ref name="blog">{{Blog|danwallace|72|Forgotten Easter Eggs}}</ref>
